items.source:
ReactiveRemoveOperation allows creation and execution of reactive MongoDB remove / findAndRemove operations in a fluent API style.
The starting domainType is used for mapping the Query provided via matching into the MongoDB specific representation. The collection to operate on is by default derived from the initial domainType and can be defined there via Document. Using inCollection allows to override the collection name for the execution. 
    
        remove(Jedi.class)
            .inCollection("star-wars")
            .matching(query(where("firstname").is("luke")))
            .all();
items.translation:
ReactiveRemoveOperation 允许以流畅的 API 风格创建和执行反应式的 MongoDB 删除/查找并删除操作。起始的 domainType 用于将通过 matching 提供的 Query 映射到 MongoDB 特定的表示形式。要操作的集合默认从初始 domainType 派生，并可通过 Document 在该处定义。使用 inCollection 可以覆盖执行时的集合名称。 
    
        remove(Jedi.class)
            .inCollection("star-wars")
            .matching(query(where("firstname").is("luke")))
            .all();

items.source: Provide a Query override (optional).
items.translation: 提供一个Query的重写（可选）。

items.source: Compose remove execution by calling one of the terminating methods.
items.translation: 通过调用终止方法之一来移除执行。

items.source: new instance of ReactiveRemoveOperation.ReactiveRemove. Never null.
items.translation: 创建一个新的ReactiveRemoveOperation.ReactiveRemove实例。绝不返回 null。
